text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER fired -> P0 queue-backlog-high (rule: inference.queue.size > 2500 for 5m) /cc @eng-oncall https://pagerduty.example/INC123456 :rotating_light:
maya_oncall: acked via PagerDuty (maya_oncall). jumping in to triage. first glance: queue backlog 6.2k, avg latency 2.4s, token drop increasing.
maya_oncall: checks dashboards: `sum(queue_length by cell)` spiked across two cells. autoscaler target nodes not increasing for 7m.
ryan_infra: looking. provider reports recent allocation failures in eu-west-1, hitting per-account instance quota. seeing `QuotaExceeded` from provider API.
alex_prod: customer impact — a small set of customers reporting 502s and degraded throughput; most requests are queued but not failing yet. CX flagged two enterprise customers. tagging @sales for notif.
maya_oncall: can we spin up fallback capacity? whats current autoscaler state?
sre_bot: autoscaler logs (last 10m):
```
I0421 14:02:10 scaler.go:234 ScaleAttempt target=48 current=26 reason=queue_high
E0421 14:03:05 provider_api.go:98 AllocateInstance error=QuotaExceeded: region limit reached
W0421 14:07:33 scaler.go:412 Cooldown active, skipping scale up
```
ryan_infra: confirmed. control-plane attempted to request 22 instances but provider rejected 18. hotspot is in cell-17 and cell-18.
maya_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) manually provision reserved nodes (if possible), 2) route new traffic to warm cells in us-east, 3) temporary rate-limit low-tier customers, 4) fall back to lower-capacity model for non-enterprise. preferences?
alex_prod: prefer 2 + 4. avoid customer-visible throttles if possible. start draining to us-east for new sessions.
ryan_infra: I'm provisioning a small warm pool from shared reserved capacity: `infractl reserve --region=eu-west-1 --count=8 --type=gpu-rtx` — may take ~6-8m. If provider still rejects, we can toggle to us-east fallback.
maya_oncall: initiating routing policy change to prefer us-east for new shards: `routectl update --policy=soft-fanout --prefer=us-east` — watch latency impact.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged (maya_oncall). Escalation to ENG-SRE triggered (ryan_infra).
alex_prod: pinging CX / acct teams with a short note: "We're seeing capacity constraints causing queued requests and higher latency. We're provisioning fallback capacity and routing new sessions to alternate cells. We'll update in 15m."
ryan_infra: manual reserve command returned 202 accepted; provisioning in progress. provisioning logs: `instance-provision start id=i-req-9c4f`
sre_bot: queue backlog peaked at 6.9k at 14:08, now 4.5k and trending down after route change.
maya_oncall: good. removing rate-limit option for now. keep monitoring. assigning followups: ryan to complete reserve and confirm node readiness; alex to coordinate customer comms; i'll continue as primary on-call until clear.
ryan_infra: nodes healthy and joined cell-17; autoscaler now sees capacity and starts scaling target=52 current=34 -> additional pods launching.
sre_bot: queue draining rate increased to 1.2k/s, backlog 1.1k at 14:24.
maya_oncall: PD timeline: fired 14:02, ack 14:03, mitigation actions started 14:06, fallback routing 14:09, reserve complete 14:17, backlog below 500 at 14:28.
pagerduty: Incident resolved -> PAGER resolved by maya_oncall.
maya_oncall: closing thread here. created follow-up ticket INF-789: request quota increase with provider + improve autoscaler cooldown behavior for multi-cell events. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex_prod: added customer postmortem note and notified affected accounts.
ryan_infra: filing provider support case (case-id: SUP-4421) and adding emergency quota request.
incident-bot: This thread will be archived.
